architecture.mechanism: Entropy generation analysis (EGA) utilizing a lumped approach to calculate total entropy generation rate within non-equilibrium thermodynamics for turbulent reacting flows
architecture.intervention: Apply lumped entropy generation analysis to the combustion chamber to identify specific sources of viscous and thermal irreversibility and optimize turbulence management to minimize total entropy production
architecture.expected_effect: Reduction in thermodynamic losses and increase in thermal conversion efficiency by minimizing entropy generation in the engine cycle
architecture.falsification_test: Constructed engine prototypes optimized via EGA must demonstrate a measurable reduction in calculated total entropy generation rate and a corresponding increase in thermal efficiency compared to standard baselines in controlled cycle tests
